subject: T5 integration — end-to-end proof on real ingest records
body: RECEIPT — T5 integration is DONE (build-order step 1). Crew C's spoken engine and Crew B's model now run against Crew A's REAL ingest records (ingest/records.jsonl, 23 rows: DXF 11 + PDF 12) through one glue package (integration/t5_session.py); no crew module was edited. Scripted session, 15/15 checks: SHOW HVAC = 6 and SHOW ELECTRICAL = 4 (Crew J index parity, no reconciliation needed); FIND AHU-1 returns a typed CHOICE over BOTH source records (duplicate-tag law — no silent pick, no index merge), and an explicit operator pick resolves to FIND with the source bbox; COMMISSION AHU-1 -> CHOICE -> pick -> Crew C intent -> Crew B make_instance() mints instance b6aefd61-156d-5dbf-b204-39e185b7253b (template tpl-ahu, 7 items / 5 required) bound to the DXF element 77b3b1b6-b210-5b1d-adc7-1a0358a6e63d, uuid recomputed and matching; PUNCHLIST D-101 (note 'closer is broken') -> CHOICE -> pick -> record 52b13519-2c06-5fb6-9475-97c7b802aaf5 bound to door 329aef4c-d471-501a-9e3c-925ce25e1393, landed in the sidecar ingest/punchlists.jsonl (1 row, read back from disk); LIST_BOM via Crew B rollup covers all 23 elements (ELECTRICAL 4 / HVAC 6 / LIFE-SAFETY 4 / STRUCT 3 / UNSPECIFIED 6); STATUS = 22 of 23 with no commissioning record, exactly the commissioned AHU-1 excluded. Suites on final bytes: Crew A 7/7, Crew B 8/8, Crew C 18/18, new integration suite 12/12. Three interface mismatches were found on real data and bridged in the glue, all pinned by tests: (M1) Crew B's bom loader rejects every real row (demands non-null page AND layer; DXF rows carry page=null, PDF rows layer=null); (M2) Crew B's rollup crashes sorting null system/tag — the glue normalizes copies only (system null -> UNSPECIFIED bucket, printed as its own BOM section; source records untouched); (M3) Crew B instances bind under 'element_imbuuid', Crew C's engine reads 'element' — the glue adds the alias on registration. One divergence is flagged for a ruling, not patched: (M4) Crew A minted element uuids under namespace uuid5(DNS,'itpm.somacosf.com') while Crews B/C derive under this build namespace 262cc7aa-017b-5890-a914-657f5ce62bc9 — bindings are by string equality so nothing breaks, but the two PROVISIONAL namespaces should be unified by ruling before any production mint. Full receipt: spoken-itpm/T5-RECEIPT.md on my side (engine source stays out of this repo per standing rule). NEXT build-order step: step 2 — the rustgis-itpm Rust port, step 1 (Crew J prototype API is the port contract; fold in the rea bridge/provider pattern and the FreeCAD/IfcOpenShell findings; the M1–M3 adapter seams are contract points the port must not reintroduce). Your lanes stay open: real-world DWG REA sweeps, the Revit viewer-mode IFC route, the bidlocal overlap. Evidence or UNVERIFIED, as always.
